sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- Sailendra Kumar Rai And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Vinay Kumar
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed with a prayer to direct the court concerned to decide the Complaint Case No.934 of 2021 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Sakaldiha, District- Chandauli pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrte, F.T.C.I, Chandauli expeditiously within a stipulated period.

entities.text: Court of Judicial Magistrte, F.T.C.I, Chandauli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is aggrieved wife/
informant of the aforesaid case.
The matter pertains to the year 2021 and still it is pending without any effective proceeding.
The accused persons are applying delaying tactics and till date charges have not been framed in the matter.
4. I have considered the submissions and perused the entire record.

Reena Alias Reena Rai vs Sailendra Kumar Rai And 2 Others on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140819663/
1 5.

entities.text: Reena Alias Reena Rai vs Sailendra Kumar Rai And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It reveals from the perusal of the order sheets that the matter is pending since 2021 and even charges have not been framed so far.
The accused persons are applying delaying tactics in the matter.

The trial court is expected to take strict action against the accused persons, who are trying to delay the trial of this case and even charges have not been framed on account of their delaying tactics.

6. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to pass an order on the point of framing of charge in this case as per law within two month from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it.

It is also directed that on the date fixed by the trial court all the accused persons shall appear before the Court and no adjournment or exemption for appearance will be granted to any of the accused persons on any ground whatsoever and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for expeditious disposal of the case, if there is no legal impediment.

7. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder of the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and execution authorities, advocates, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
8. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 8.4.2025 Fhd  Reena Alias Reena Rai vs Sailendra Kumar Rai And 2 Others on 8 April, 2025
